description: Genuine SPHEREx observations: derived native-pixel FITS upload samples
acknowledgement: This publication makes use of data products from the Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization and Ices Explorer (SPHEREx), which is a joint project of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the California Institute of Technology, and is funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.

samples.kind: Derived native-pixel spatial subset; not archive-issued
limitations: Native orientation retained; WCS reprojection is required for blink.
EPSF and approximate WCS-WAVE tables are omitted; this is an upload adapter sample.
Pixels have different wavelengths. Compare only wavelength-compatible overlapping pixels.
No PSF matching, covariance model or detection of motion/variability.
